description: FEAT-008 batch-2: insert several components in ONE creo_execute_plan job on an existing managed assembly. The job saves, erases and reloads once at the end; the result keeps the usual preview.jpg and adds a bounded component_changes summary. Repeat occurrences of the same source reuse its adopted model_id but use distinct component labels.

operations.label: base_plate_flip
operations.source_model_id: <adopted source model_id (first path, same as base_plate)>

expect.job: status succeeded; result.saved_file_reloaded_and_verified is true; revision increments by 1 for the whole job

component_changes.changes: one added entry per operation above with real feature_id, source_model_id and source_revision

expect.readback: creo_list_components returns three components; fixed constraints carry numeric type plus type_name "fix"
